Hello, hello!
I am the official Name Rater!{VAR BE01}
Want me to rate the nicknames
of your Pokémon?

Which Pokémon's nickname
should I critique?{VAR BE01}

Excellent! What would you like
the new nickname to be?{VAR BE01}

Done! From now on, this Pokémon
shall be known as {VAR 0102 0000}!{VAR BE01}
You're right, that does seem to fit it
better. Nicely done!

OK! Come see me again if you
change your mind.

Now, now...
That is merely an Egg!
